design: Discrete-time hazard models on 1994 ZDHS + 1992 census
notes: District mean schooling is not randomly assigned; the design controls for own education and urbanization but nothing eliminates the correlation of district education with district development. As a NULL result the confounding runs in the paper's favour -- an unadjusted estimate would be biased toward finding the contextual effect the paper fails to find -- so the null is more informative than the design's rating alone suggests.

Same contextual-versus-individual logic and the same confounding problem, but with a positive result, where confounding is not benign: cohort schooling rises alongside everything else that delays marriage. Outcome is marital timing, not a birth.

study: Pesando Sarkar & Kornrich — India partnership ideals
notes: Online-technology exposure is self-selected; women who seek online content plausibly already hold different partnership ideals. Reverse causality is unaddressed and the outcome is a stated ideal measured in the same instrument as the exposure, so common-method bias applies.
